note: Supplemental pieces pack, NOT a full environment replacement. Meant to merge into the forest-v4.1 package already used by the game (forest-proof map, fp4_ prefix) -- see README.md "Integracao" for how game-dev should wire this in (new prefix or merged into fp4_* namespace, aliases.json update, both out of game-art write scope).

presets.night: not produced in this pack -- see README.md Limitacoes

autotile.pattern: 16-tile blob (same geometry as forest-v4 path_blob/denseedge_blob), bitmask = N*1 + E*2 + S*4 + W*8, 1 = same-type (water) neighbor present
autotile.cornerRule: Each tile corner independently rounded via a quarter-circle cut (R=0 both neighbors water / R=7 one neighbor / R=12 neither) with 1px seeded dither along the arc, same as forest-v4.
autotile.foamEdge: Additional pass not present in path_blob/denseedge_blob: boundary pixels within ~2px of the corner arc get a 55% chance of a waterFoam (Endesga-32 c19) fleck, so every shore edge shows foam without a separate foam tile.

sets.name: water_blob
sets.surround: grass (reuses forest_v4_tiles.js grassVariant as the background, so it matches whatever grass_NN is already on the ground layer)

Single closed state only -- no open/empty state produced yet (see README.md Limitacoes).
Board is blank except a placeholder "!" mark -- per-map sign text is a data/UI concern (a tooltip or popup keyed by map object id), not baked into the pixel art.
Non-collision: the player stands on it to trigger the heal. No animation (static glow) -- see README.md Limitacoes.
